competitions.eligibility: 不限户籍地域，有意在珠海创业或已创业者均可；截至报名时未注册、或截至 2026-09-30（含）注册未满5 年的自然人独资/控股公司；参赛人员年满 16 周岁、为创始人或核心成员，每项目不超 3 人，OPC 企业社保不超 5 人（以 2026 年 8 月参保数据为准）；高校组（在校或毕业两年内）/ 社会组（毕业超两年、从业者、创业者）不得兼报
competitions.stage: OPC（一人公司）模式开展 AI 项目，需有自主创新产品、核心技术或差异化商业模式
competitions.prize: 高校组、社会组各设一等 1 名、二等 2 名、三等 3 名、优秀奖 6 名；已注册企业一等 6 万 / 二等 4 万 / 三等 2 万，未注册项目分段资助（一等 3 万 + 落地注册后 3 万）；配套两年免租孵化、算力券最高 200 万、模型券最高 100 万、担保贷款个人 60 万 / 小微 500 万、人才房「一免两减」、投融资对接与港澳专项
tracks: AI 硬件创新及设计（芯片/智能终端/具身智能/边缘计算）
AI 软件与智能体创新（垂直行业 AI、轻量工具、Agent、多智能体协同）
AIGC 创新及 AI 衍生应用（图文音视频/3D 生成、AI 安全、文旅数字孪生）
competitions.format: 即日起至 11-10 报名（材料提交至 zhuhaiopccyds@163.com）→ 11 月下旬资格审核 → 12 月上旬初赛书面评审（各组 25 个晋级）→ 12 月下旬复赛路演答辩（各组 12 个晋级）→ 决赛暨颁奖

competitions.name: 2026 年中国（广西）—东盟「AI+法律」应用创新大赛
competitions.organizer: 广西壮族自治区司法厅 × 梧州市人民政府（广西 2026 年「AI 赋能千行百业」超级联赛 A 超组成部分）
competitions.eligibility: 面向中国内地、港澳台及东盟各国企业、高校学生、科研院所、初创团队、个人开发者；团队 2-5 人且须明确一名负责人，鼓励跨国界跨领域联合组队；同一人只能参加一个团队
competitions.stage: 已落地产品、行业解决方案、原型系统、算法模型、数据平台或创新研究成果均可；须为原创或取得完整合法授权
competitions.prize: 三大赛道各设一等 2 名、二等 3 名、三等 5 名，颁发证书及奖金；配套优先对接创投机构与孵化载体、优先推荐申报广西科技创新「智果」行动计划定向支持，优秀成熟项目向全区司法行政系统及法律服务机构推介并纳入人才与企业资源库
tracks: 六大业务方向：政府立法与依法行政/刑罚执行与监管安全/公共法律服务/法治宣传/面向东盟法律服务/行业数据集与垂直模型
competitions.format: 8-31 启动 → 10-15 报名截止（修改材料至 10-20）→ 10-20 至 10-25 线上初赛 → 11 月中旬决赛（广西南宁，线上+线下结合）；自治区数据局发布涉外法律服务、跨境合规审查等真实业务场景，中国电信提供技术平台与算力支撑

competitions.name: 2026 中国互联网发展创新与投资大赛（深圳）
competitions.organizer: 中央网信办信息化发展局、广东省委网信办指导，中国互联网发展基金会、中国互联网投资基金、深圳市委网信办联合主办，深圳市互联网行业联合会承办
competitions.eligibility: 企业组面向已合法注册、项目进入市场且拥有自主知识产权的中小微企业；创客组面向个人、团队、海归人才、高校创客和科研团队
competitions.stage: 项目已进入市场（企业组）或处于创意/原型阶段（创客组）
competitions.prize: 投融资对接、园区落地、产业资源链接、媒体宣传等多维赋能；汇聚中国互联网投资基金、深创投等 20 余家投资机构；自 2020 年落地深圳以来五届累计吸引海内外 2000 余家企业与创新创业团队
competitions.format: 全球项目征集 → 评审 → 决赛（深圳），打通「以赛促投、以赛促融」生态链路

competitions.name: SusHi Tech Challenge 2027 (Tokyo)
competitions.organizer: SusHi Tech Tokyo (Tokyo Metropolitan Government)
competitions.eligibility: Startups with new technology or business model with growth potential and an existing product/service, aligned with the sustainable-city concept; must be able to exhibit at the venue all three event days; all materials and pitches in English
competitions.stage: Early stage with existing product or service
competitions.prize: Grand Prize JPY 10 million; 20 semifinalists get booth fee waiver (JPY 300,000), VC/corporate pitch opportunities, investor networking, plus special awards from corporate partners and Tokyo Metropolitan Government promotion channels; 800+ startups applied last year
competitions.format: Applications Oct 2, 2026 - Dec 18, 2026 → screening Jan-Feb 2027 → 20 semifinalists → Semifinal May 20, Final May 21, 2027 at Tokyo Big Sight; judged on social impact, economic impact, global expansion potential, pitch skills

competitions.name: 第十届中关村国际前沿科技大赛 · 领域赛
competitions.organizer: 北京市科学技术委员会、中关村科技园区管理委员会（承办：中关村高科技产业促进中心、北京科技成果转化服务中心、北京新技术应用促进中心）
competitions.eligibility: 境内外注册企业，主营新兴产业前沿技术产品研发、生产及服务，知识产权清晰无纠纷；在京注册企业注册时间须在 2019-08-01 之后，京外或境外注册企业无年限限制；上市公司及往届冠亚季军企业不得参赛；已报名起点赛的企业不得重复报名；每家企业仅可选一个领域
competitions.stage: 已注册成立的成长期企业（面向境内外）
competitions.prize: 各领域前 10 名获「中关村前沿科技 TOP10」称号并纳入北京市科技计划项目储备库；前 3 名可享最高 30 万元科技型小微企业研发资金支持；总决赛冠军 100 万元、亚军 50 万元、季军 30 万元，优胜奖 7 名各 15 万元
competitions.format: 项目征集（截至 2026-10-31）→ 各领域初赛、复赛（2026-11 至 2027-02，初赛函评、复赛路演，评选各领域前 10 名，前 3 名晋级半决赛）→ 半决赛（2027-03 上旬，约 60 个项目公开路演，前 10 名晋级）→ 总决赛（2027-03 下旬，公开路演现场打分）

competitions.name: Future Innovators Competition 2027 (Go Digital Energy Summit)
competitions.organizer: Globuc (Go Digital Energy Summit)
competitions.eligibility: Early-stage startups with a working prototype (min. TRL 5) or early commercial product; under 5 years in market; max 20 employees; under $1.5M ARR. Companies exceeding those thresholds should use exhibition options instead
competitions.stage: Early stage, TRL 5+
competitions.prize: Complimentary exhibition stand in the Innovation Zone at the next event; 7-minute main-stage pitch to 200+ decision-makers; featured video interview and 1 complimentary VIP pass to the Go Digital Energy Summit
competitions.format: Online application → 5 finalists → 7-minute pitches on the main stage at Go Digital Energy Summit, 11 Feb 2027, London

competitions.name: HIPTHER AI & Cybersecurity Startup Challenge 2027
competitions.organizer: HIPTHER
competitions.eligibility: Early-stage AI or cybersecurity startups from Europe and beyond; investment terms to be standardized and published in the official Competition Rules before applications open
competitions.stage: Early stage
competitions.prize: €40,000 investment for the overall winner (equity structure and vehicle to be confirmed); Top 20 announced end of February, online semifinals in early March, Final 8 live in Prague
competitions.format: Applications Nov 16, 2026 - Jan 31, 2027 → eligibility review Feb 1-14 → jury evaluation to end of February → Top 20 → online semifinals ~Mar 10 → Final 8 → live final Mar 25, 2027 at HIPTHER AI Summit, Prague. Round One: 8 startups, 5-min pitch + 5-min Q&A; Final Four: 5-min pitch + 10-min interrogation

competitions.name: The Pitch by Deel 2027
competitions.organizer: Deel
competitions.eligibility: Startups based anywhere in the world with a full-time founder, incorporated entity, no industry restriction; open to pre-seed, seed and Series A companies
competitions.stage: Pre-seed / Seed / Series A
competitions.prize: Up to 10 global winners receive $1M investment; up to 100 regional winners receive $50k SAFE investment; travel subsidies to the global finals
competitions.format: 3-minute online application → regional finals in Tel Aviv, Dubai, Singapore, Berlin, London, Paris and New York (Mar-May 2027) → global finals. Up to 100 regional winners get $50k; up to 10 global winners compete for $1M

competitions.name: SuperAI Genesis AI Startup Competition 2027
competitions.organizer: SuperAI (Singapore)
competitions.eligibility: Seed or growth-stage AI startups with products ready for commercialisation; shortlisting from hundreds of global applicants to 10 finalists pitching on 8-9 Sep 2027; participation free (flights and accommodation not covered)
competitions.stage: Seed to growth stage
competitions.prize: Share of the prize pool (equity-free); complimentary exhibition space at SuperAI 2028; additional rewards to be announced. Genesis 2026 ran with a $2.3M prize pool; all 10 finalists receive exhibition stand, speaker entitlements, 4 team tickets and full conference access
competitions.format: Join the 2027 waitlist now; applications open later (no formal interview round, video application showcasing the product in real time) → 50 shortlisted → 10 pitch live at SuperAI, 8-9 Sep 2027, Marina Bay Sands, Singapore

competitions.name: 第十一届全国青年人工智能创新创业大赛
competitions.organizer: 中国人工智能学会（CAAI）主办，哈尔滨工业大学（深圳）承办，哈工大（深圳）光明科技产业创新院协办
competitions.eligibility: 创新赛道分学生组（全日制在校生，含港澳台及教育部认证的海外高校）和青年组（科研院所/新型研发机构青年科研人员、在站博士后、企业核心研发成员，40 周岁以下即 1986-12-31 后出生）；创业赛道面向合法注册且从事 AI 相关技术研发/产品开发/服务的企业，或 AI 领域创业个人；每队 1-7 名成员（含 1 名队长，每人限报一队），指导教师 0-2 人；作品须拥有完全知识产权、无权属争议
competitions.stage: 创意、原型到已注册企业均可，按赛道区分
competitions.prize: 各赛道分设特等奖、一等奖、二等奖，颁发获奖证书并在官方平台公示；创新赛道奖项可作为硕博升学、海外留学、求职的科研能力证明；创业赛道获奖项目有机会获得企业投资、技术合作及媒体曝光；配套技术·能力·资本三位一体赋能（产学研资对接、阶梯化创业培训）
tracks: 创新赛道（前沿技术突破与科研转化）
创业赛道（成熟技术商业化落地）
「揭榜挂帅」专项赛（企业真实技术难题）
competitions.format: 报名截止 2026-11-30 24:00（腾讯问卷报名 + PPT 材料发至 IQCS_SouthCHN@163.com）→ 初赛 2026 年 12 月初专家评审 → 总决赛 2026 年 12 月末深圳现场答辩；不收报名费

competitions.name: 2026 江苏创青春「人工智能+住房城乡建设」创新创业大赛
competitions.organizer: 江苏省住房和城乡建设厅、共青团江苏省委、江苏省数据局、江苏省科协联合主办
competitions.eligibility: 个人或团队均可报名，团队须明确 1 名负责人；项目须符合国家产业政策导向、具备自主知识产权、不侵犯第三方权利，使用开源代码或第三方技术须标注来源与协议版本；数据使用须合规
competitions.stage: 开放赛道不限阶段，「揭榜挂帅」应用赛道按后续公告
competitions.prize: 「科技创新」开放赛道各分赛道设一、二、三等奖和优秀奖；「揭榜挂帅」应用赛道设最佳场景奖、应用创新奖、技术价值奖和优秀奖；不收报名费，不委托任何机构开展有偿培训
tracks: 人工智能+住房城乡建设
competitions.format: 「科技创新」开放赛道报名 10-28 至 11-16，通过赛事官方平台提交项目资料 → 11 月下旬预赛 → 12 月上旬决赛；「揭榜挂帅」应用赛道安排由组委会另行公告

competitions.name: 2027 NIA Start-Up Challenge and Accelerator
competitions.organizer: National Institute on Aging (NIA), U.S. National Institutes of Health
competitions.eligibility: Early-stage entrepreneurs and researchers new to entrepreneurship proposing science-driven technologies for healthy aging; particular interest in solutions leveraging AI (data-driven / machine learning for early detection, risk prediction, personalized interventions, drug discovery). Team Lead must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident to receive a cash prize
competitions.stage: Pre-seed / idea to early prototype
competitions.prize: Up to $994,000 total cash prizes: $24,000 for up to 21 finalist teams plus $70,000 for 7 winning teams; entrepreneurial training, 1:1 mentorship from founders and investors, pitch coaching, and introductions to NIA/NIH SBIR-STTR funding
competitions.format: Submissions open Dec 1, 2026 - Jan 15, 2027 → Stage 1 finalists announced May 2027 → accelerator Jun-Nov 2027 → final submission and pitch Nov 2027 → Stage 2 winners Jan 2028; informational webinar Dec 3, 2026
